steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: This is a tough one.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: It's analyzing our combat styles and nullifying our attacks.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: We've tried to adapt our tactics many times—
Working in conjunction with Logos, Ascalon, and Misery's attacks have quickly destroyed the mimic machine's legs.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Keep it going. We must learn from each attack and be creative too—
The mimic machine has already fell countless times under the team's coordinated attacks, but each time it stands back up.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Look out! It's charging up again.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: It keeps repairing itself with Originium.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: We can't let it wear us down.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: We need to destroy that rhombus eye.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: I have just the arrow for the job.
Two arrows leave Stormeye's bow as the words leave his mouth.
One breaks the mimic machine's shield, but the other is stopped just before it reaches the rhombus-shaped eye...
The mimic machine has finished charging. Bright red light bursts out—
Then Rosmontis's Arts force the arrow into the eye of the mimic machine.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Do you hurt?
Kaboom.
Rosmontis's Arts block the eye of terror at the exact moment of its outburst, sending overflowing energy into every direction in the Abyss.
The spinning bone pen floats on top of Mechanist's head, shielding him from the rampant energy.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Thanks, Logos. Good thing you guys distracted the thing.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: External attacks are ineffective. We're counting on you to find a way through from inside.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: How are we doing, Mechanist?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: After talking to Closure, we're certain that this is a special Sarcophagus.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: It's not just a hibernation device; it's also what truly stores PRTS's data and supplies it with power.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: The backdoor Dr. Kal'tsit left us will allow me to connect directly to PRTS's core server.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I'll destroy all the data once I've downloaded PRTS's core data.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Is this the only way to put that big guy to rest?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: How long do you need?
Mechanist glances at his equipment.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Two-hundred forty seconds!

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: We'll buy the time for you.
The sound of the bone whistle echoes in the Abyss. Logos returns to the elite operators' ranks.
The mimic machine once again stands up before them.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname} trusts you implicitly. Even with a fractured memory—

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname} believes you are hope.

options: Don't let her distract you, Amiya!
We just need to buy a little more time for the others...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You should get ready to retreat—

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: There is no way out for Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: We will inevitably end up on the same path, our subjective sentiments notwithstanding.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: You and I need not be in opposition, Amiya. I can make your wish come true.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: You always trusted me.
Countless eyes look at you from the crystals. Priestess's eyes.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: You made the same promise to me. We can find the answer to the ultimate question together.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Time is short, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I don't need to lie to you.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: This humanitarianism that you think you're advocating simply serves to extend the suffering of Terrans before the inevitable fall of Terra.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Any questions that you still have, I can answer them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She's getting weaker, Doctor!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Most of the operators have evacuated. Maybe, maybe...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I want to try—

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: You want to kill me?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Is this what you want too... Dr. {@nickname}?
'Priestess'.
There are still so many secrets within her that you want to find out, about yourself, about Kal'tsit, about Originium, about that impending threat...
But you know that where she stands inevitably makes her the enemy of all Terra.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: You missed your chance.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Stay, Dr. {@nickname}—
You could hardly imagine the ordeal that Amiya has gone through. She is already well past her limit.
All the threads shatter, and Originium once again closes in upon you.
You try to escape the crystals, carrying Amiya in your arms, but the rampant growth of Originium has sealed the path—

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Made it in time.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Mechanist and Closure have successfully retrieved the core data of PRTS.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: We will cover your retreat.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Now. Go!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wait... there's one more thing!
With what little strength she has left, Amiya conjures a few strands of threads, and pulls the cocoon that was Mon3tr into her arms.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I need your help, Touch!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: These patients were transferred from intensive care. We don't have enough emergency equipment.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I need you to stabilize their conditions first.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: Try to gather all the wounded here, and leave the rest to me.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: Casualty report?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Things are still very much in flux. We don't have a hard figure.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Current injury estimates are thirty-one serious, one hundred seventy-three minor. No deaths yet.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: We were able to complete the evacuation ahead of schedule, thanks to the safe zone created by Logos and Mechanist, and the help that you and Pith provided.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: ...One dead. A patient.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I'll report in detail to the Doctor and Kal—
She stops in mid-sentence.
They have all been avoiding that name.
The one who had always tended to the wounded after each operation.
Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: Help the others establish the isolation zone. We need to keep an eye on the ship to make sure no enemies get out.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: ...Roger.

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: Warfarin—

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I'm already doing my best to stay focused, Touch.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Now is not the time.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: What's the situation with Dr. {@nickname} and Amiya?

steps.name: Touch
steps.text: We all need some time to process what happened.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: We're at the isolation zone outside the ship. It's safe enough for now.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Is Amiya okay?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Rhodes Island—
That ship which you once called home is now completely encased in a massive Originium crystal.
The wind blows over it, blurring its outline with sand and dust. You know that you have lost Rhodes Island.
You hold Amiya in your arms. She is unconscious, but still holding that crystalline cocoon in her own arms.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Doctor. Rhodes Island...

options: Our greatest threat at present still lies within.
We must prepare ourselves before we confront her again.
I'm not sure what this name truly stands for.
But I will not forgive her.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: What... happened to Dr. Kal'tsit?
The others who escaped the Originium-blockaded area begin to gather.
Yet no one feels relieved, despite the successful evacuation.
Ascalon's question weighs heavily on everyone's hearts.
No one could have seen this coming—
You feel dazed as you look at the black crystal that an unconscious Amiya still clings desperately to.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: What next?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: So... We've lost it?

options: No. Rhodes Island is never lost.
All of you are here. Always have been.

steps.text: Can you hear me, Doctor? This is Vina.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I heard about Rhodes Island. I'm very sorry.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: The nomadic plate that Dr. Kal'tsit purchased near Butchart is nearing completion.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I'll be coming to visit soon. Let me know if you need anything.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Take care, you and Amiya...

steps.name: Reserve Guard Operator
steps.text: Midnight asked me to bring this wine back from Siracusa, Popukar.

steps.name: Reserve Guard Operator
steps.text: He said it was a... Brunello specialty. I'm not a wine expert, though. Is he getting better?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: He's still locked up in Medical. Dr. Warfarin grounded him.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: He got hurt dealing with those weird things coming out of the ship, which made Dr. Warfarin really nervous.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I'll give these to Midnight.

steps.name: Reserve Guard Operator
steps.text: Uh... what exactly happened?

steps.name: Reserve Guard Operator
steps.text: I heard a bunch of versions. Some say the ship came alive and turned into a monster...

steps.name: Reserve Guard Operator
steps.text: Some say they saw friends and family they thought were dead... then our ship was gone, just like that—

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Well, I'm not too sure either...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: It all happened so fast. I was listening to Raidian and Dr. Kal'tsit—
Dr. Kal'tsit.
Her absence will take some getting used to.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Looks like we can complete the assembly earlier than scheduled.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: The main connectors of this nomadic plate had already been modified to fit our equipment. The hardest part was already taken care of.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: The construction has been going much quicker than expected, thanks to all the operators who provided help.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Logos's incantations saved us a lot of effort moving stuff, and Raidian saved a lot of time by checking the circuits for us.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Angelina even came back to help us do the heavy lifting!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: All that stuff laid out on deck in an orderly manner in the blink of an eye—sorry, I'm getting ahead of myself.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: It's fine. We're all excited to hear that things are going smoothly.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: But I guess you're here for something else. Is there a problem?

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Well, yes.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Some of the pipes are so narrow that even these guys couldn't get them checked.

steps.name: 'Beepy'
steps.text: (Comes out from behind the engineer looking frustrated)

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Has Closure fixed these already?

steps.name: 'Beepy'
steps.text: (Lowers head in shame)

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: What happened on the ship wasn't your fault, little fella.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: We need to think of a way—

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: The Doctor said I'm needed here.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: —Ray?!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I was wondering why Closure rushed me over here, until I overheard your conversation.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: If you need to check the pipes...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: This little runt oughta come in useful.

steps.name: Sandbeast
steps.text: (Slowly stretches its backfin)

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Thank you for the detailed report on the incident, Closure.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No worries. It's just part of the deal.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Yes, I understand. I'll report back to Consuls Clementia and Gladiia and communicate your warning.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: As for the name of the individual—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: 'Priestess'.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: We will reference our own databanks.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: If the name has also appeared in any records of Ægir, then the threat you encountered was no coincidence.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: I'll let you know about the results as soon as possible. We will also review the Joint Marine Corps deployment of the other consuls.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Once you are ready, we will deliver the necessary equipment, including medical facilities and Catastrophe warning systems.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: You're growing into your position, Closure.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh, please, spare me.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I would much rather be dealing with machines.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I didn't expect Kal'tsit's job to be this hard...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Are you getting ready to leave?

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: No time to waste.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Babel must be informed about the details of this incident. Kazdel will check the status of Amnannam on our behalf.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Remember to tell Wiš'adel that the Doctor recommends exercising maximum caution in reviewing the use of that piece of Originium.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Don't worry, the Doctor already hammered the point in. I'll be going, then.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You're not saying goodbye to the others?

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: They've got plenty to do as things stand.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: There's just one thing. About what happened to Dr. Kal'tsit... should we tell Babel?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Tell Wiš'adel first. She'll want to know.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Let her decide whether to tell the others. I trust her on this.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Tracking you down wasn't easy, Closure. What's going on with the thing that I asked?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We got Nuova Volsinii's response. The new batch of medical equipment will be shipped in through their port.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The Engineering Department is expecting to complete the construction of the medical lab that you requested in three days.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Good. The medical center should be ready to accept patients, in that case.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Kal'tsit bought this plate a long time ago. It's much bigger than the old Rhodes Island, and it feels much more like an 'island'.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: But it's going to take some time for things to go back to the way they were before.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Don't worry. I've made things modular from the get-go this time, which should make future upgrades much easier.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: One more thing—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: About her office...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Just rebuild it the way it was. Medical will maintain it.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: You know, this really is going to take some getting used to.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'll help the Doctor and Amiya with the administrative stuff as much as I can while she's gone.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I don't want to disappoint her.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I'll help with things in Medical.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Did the Doctor and Amiya talk to you about recovering the other modules?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Of course. They're very energetic about it. Everything is progressing smoothly.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But it will take time to fully rebuild Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Retrieving the original equipment, building supply channels, restoring communications with local branches, external PR, debriefing returning operators—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The list of things that need to be done just goes on and on.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Which reminds me... about that patient, Chloe...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I've sent someone to the Londinium office to locate her family.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: The paper that Chloe and I were co-authoring is almost complete. It will be submitted to all the major medical journals on Terra.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Her sacrifice has helped achieve a true breakthrough in the research of Originium's mutative properties, and the resulting new symptoms of Oripathy.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I must bring this to the attention of more professionals, and make sure that her memory lives on in the minds of more people...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yes, we couldn't have done it without her.
Closure rubs her eyes.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Overwork is bad for you.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yeah, the Doctor told me not to push myself too far. But...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Trying to paralyze yourself with work may do the job for a while, but you'll eventually end up harming yourself.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Doctor's advice.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...All of Rhodes Island is my responsibility now.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Besides, Kal'tsit had even more on her plate.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Then come to Medical one of these days. I'll get you checked up.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Your blood doesn't even smell of machine oil these days. HR is telling me to keep a close eye on you.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Okay... Thanks...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Are the Doctor and Amiya still observing 'Mon3tr' in that forest of yours?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I still think it should be done on the ship. I can provide support—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: This new Rhodes Island can't afford risks.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: You think that Priestess may have tampered with what Kal'tsit left behind?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No one knows.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The rain seems to be getting heavier.
You prop up your coat, shielding Amiya from the sudden shower.
The edge of Amiya's skirt is already all wet, but she does not seem concerned.
She is fully focused on the grass field a short distance away.
Wrapped in Kal'tsit's clothing, the black crystal emanates a dark, flowing green light.
It is rather inconspicuous in the dark and wet surroundings.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The light is appearing more and more frequently in recent days.

options: There are no apparent changes in the surrounding Originium.
Maybe Mon3tr has not been affected by Priestess.

steps.text: You wait and watch, fighting to suppress your hope for a miracle.
For the past month, Amiya has accompanied you on your regular trips to monitor the status of the crystal.
You all needed some time to process what happened.
And you cannot help but hope that the next time you come...
That she will be waiting here for you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor! Look!
Complex veins meander across the hard surface of the dark-green crystal. It sinks into the ground, then a highly regular shard begins growing, spreading into numerous branches—
The branches continue to grow until they come to a halt at some point, as though someone had cut off its end with scissors.
In this lush forest, the green crystal on the grass seems to become one with the land, as though it was always there.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's not quite what Theresa witnessed...
The crystal does not stop growing. The branches increase in number, expanding like the verdant crown of a tree, and the veins grow ever more complex and varied.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Can you tell what those veins represent?

options: They're all interconnected in a fluid cycle.
It's like a particular way of storing data.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Storing data?
Kal'tsit's life.
The myriad branches once again merge together, forming a massive cocoon.
All possibilities collapse into one reality.
The symbiont that had been by Kal'tsit's side ever since she awoke will continue to carry her hope, even after she is gone.
It is both a burden and a gift.
Besides, she never had a choice. This was a power that she was born with—
You hear an unfamiliar voice.
...Kal'tsit?
The rain caresses her palms.
An everyday natural phenomenon, so alien to her sensations.
She smells the grass, touches the cold rain... she instinctively puts on the clothes in her hands.
Kal'tsit's clothes.
Kal'tsit...?
She calls Kal'tsit's name in uncertainty. Kal'tsit had always been by her side. She had never been alone before.
No new symbiont has emerged to watch over her, only the two of you in the distance.
She looks up blankly at the sky, trying to process all the memories she possesses, all the memories that belong to AMa-10...
The memories that belong to Kal'tsit.
She recalls her last memory.
On that familiar deck, she fought side-by-side with Kal'tsit against Priestess—
...You gave me freedom.
I can see your memories, all of them...
But I can't sense your presence anymore.
Kal'tsit. Your name... a name that I loved so much—

spans.text: Your name... a name that I loved so much—

steps.text: But it belongs only to you.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: My name is Mon3tr.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: You gave me this name.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: These clothes... did Closure prepare them for me?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Hmm. Not quite a perfect fit.)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Why are you looking at me like that, Dr. {@nickname}?
You mime out the shape of the Mon3tr that you know, much larger than the figure in front of you.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: It's me, Doctor.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: What? No, I don't think so.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do you remember what happened?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Yes. I faced Priestess together with Kal'tsit, my maker...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Then I lost her.
You and Amiya fall silent.
This is not the outcome you expected, though it is undoubtedly a miracle.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Where are we?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: New Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We lost the old one in the chaos... Priestess has sealed it in Originium.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Hm—that's Priestess's doing?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Doctor... does Mon3tr feel a little... weird?)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (It's like—)

options: (Like she's getting used to her new body.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (I don't sense anything abnormal with her emotions.)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: What happened to Priestess?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're not sure. Rhodes Island is completely encased in Originium, making it nearly impossible to penetrate.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're keeping it under observation until we're fully prepared for our next move.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Kal'tsit has left behind some important information... but my mind is a mess. I need your help.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Of course. But we'll need to get you checked out at the new base first.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is important for your own health, and for the safety of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You'll need to keep a low profile, until we fully understand what's going on with you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right now, there are still a lot of operators hoping that we'll bring Dr. Kal'tsit home.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Give them some time, and give us some time... I'm sorry, Mon3tr.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Kal'tsit would have approved of your decision.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I will cooperate with you, fully—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Say, uh, can I consider myself a Rhodes Island Operator now?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Just like Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I asked Kal'tsit so many times before, but she kept coming up with excuses to refuse me!

options: Do you agree with Rhodes Island's ideals?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Well... I can't say I don't have any misgivings about the present situation, but I've never doubted Kal'tsit.

options: Rhodes Island will never turn away a friend who has always been by our side.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Doctor? Where are you going?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Give the Doctor some space for a while, Mon3tr.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So you're sure there are no other issues, Dr. Warfarin?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I've conducted a full examination of Mon3tr under her guidance. I didn't find any trace of Priestess's influence.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: But Mon3tr and Kal'tsit were always full of secrets. There's a lot of research that I want to try—

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: (Kal'tsit was never so cooperative with exams!)

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: But I have a paper to write.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: You're not going to review the information Kal'tsit left with us?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I'd love to, but not now.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: This is a moment for Dr. {@nickname} and Amiya to share. I can wait for a better time.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: (Take good care of her, Doctor.)

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: (I was surprised by Mon3tr's frankness when I was with her.)

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: (She may have all of Kal'tsit's memories, but it's hard for me to treat them as the same person.)
You watch Mon3tr curiously fiddling with the command center equipment, as Amiya explains to her the additions to the newly rebuilt room.
She is very different from Kal'tsit, but they have the same strong, resolute eyes.

options: We'll take good care of her, Warfarin.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Come find me if you need anything, Mon3tr.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Doctor, Amiya said that the command system hasn't been fully restored?

options: Closure is working on a new PRTS.
But deciphering the PRTS source code has proven to be a challenge.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I can help.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Since Kal'tsit broke through her limit, I am now able to decipher the associated code.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Restoring the command system is a priority for our future operations.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Great! That's one headache gone.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I'll ask Closure to do something about it. For now...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I won't give up on searching for any messages Kal'tsit might have left—

a.text: Attendant AMa-10 symbiont memory conversion complete.

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: If you've accessed this log, that means—

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: You are free.

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: You are not just 'Kal'tsit's symbiont' anymore. Nor are you a vehicle of the AMa-10 cycle.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: ...Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: (Chuckling) I wonder what name you will choose.

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: Will you keep the name 'Kal'tsit'?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I like this name, but it belongs to you.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: ...'Mon3tr'. I choose the name you gave me.

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: To be honest, I don't want you to have to carry the burden represented by this name.

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: Someone gave me the freedom to seek the meaning of life. You deserve the same chance.

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: Go forth and find the meaning of your life. Let your heart answer for yourself your expectations for this land—

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: Is it hope, or destruction?

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: I'm sorry that I can't be with you anymore, until you've found the answer.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: But I have so many questions...
Mon3tr remembers the questions that Warfarin raised to her while examining her—
'Why choose a similar form to Kal'tsit, instead of something more efficient and resilient?'
'Why hide your claws? So that others will not fear you?'
'Why have you chosen to remain human?'

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I don't know... I just chose it on instinct.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: There are many answers that come to my lips, but I just can't find the right words...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I can't think like you, Kal'tsit. Too much information, too many memories. My mind is a mess...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: I want to find a way to bring you back, but—

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: But you will never doubt your own decision.

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: We've walked the centuries together. I know full well that you already know the answer.

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: You just need some time to understand yourself.

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: Keep moving forward.
The voice stops.
You and Amiya do not want to disturb.
You can feel Amiya trying to hold her emotions back too.
You step closer to her, to give her comfort.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, I...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: ...This is—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: For the Doctor and Amiya?

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, Amiya. I tried to envision the circumstances under which you will hear this recording.

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: I hope you don't find this baffling—

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: The destruction of Rhodes Island was not unexpected.

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: We face a foe far stronger than any other that we have faced before. I have failed.

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: But your war has only just begun.

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: Increasingly active Originium will bring new challenges. More pain, more suffering, more hatred, more war...

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: Remember the mission of Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: Gather the strength of the operators scattered across Terra. You will need unity, consolidated force.

steps.name: Familiar Voice
steps.text: This war is one of all Terra.

options: There's always a Plan B, isn't there?
Is this all she had to say in the end?

steps.text: Sensing your emotions, Amiya grips your hand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's okay, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If it hurts, say so.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I won't touch your emotions without permission... But I want to share the burden.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Me too... Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I promised Dr. Kal'tsit that I would do my duty and protect the Doctor. I'll do it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This time, I will not cry until Rhodes Island's mission is complete.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I really miss her.
The girl does not answer. She is focused on the databank before her, searching for something.
A massive amount of data scrolls before her eyes, and her gaze grows intent.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: There's so much...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: She left so much data that I never got to access.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: Maybe there's a way... it's possible...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: There is a way, Doctor...

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: We can bring Kal'tsit back.

a.text: For now, allow me to call you by the name that we chose together, Mon3tr.
People pour love into life and long for salvation whether in hope or fear. That's why they choose to pray to gods that they've never seen...
But how could it come true? Even the most tired river must eventually flow into the ocean.
When the final moment comes, when sun, moon and stars fade... when the swaying waves no longer murmur, when all sound and sights are gone.
When the colors of winter and spring are no more, and the boundary of night and day blurs—
And only eternal slumber in endless night remains.
It was a poem that my maker read to me when we were lying upon the frozen earth, both exhausted from playing.
Eternal life is destined to be eternally lonely. I have known how it feels.
I am sure you too can walk alone—
